messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Text: Sometimes it is not safe to use certain medicines at the same time.
Some drugs can affect your blood levels of other drugs you use.
This may increase side effects.
This may make the medicines less effective.
If you also take sucralfate, take your furosemide dose 2 hours before or 2 hours after you take sucralfate.
Tell your doctor about all your other medicines, especially:
another diuretic (do not use furosemide with ethacrynic acid)
methotrexate
chloral hydrate
lithium
phenytoin
an antibiotic, especially a cephalosporin or an aminoglycoside (avoid using aminoglycosides with furosemide)
cancer medicine, such as cisplatin
cyclosporine
thyroid hormones
heart or blood pressure medicine, including ACE inhibitors and angiotensin receptor blockers
NSAIDs (nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs), such as aspirin, ibuprofen (Advil, Motrin), naproxen (Aleve), celecoxib, diclofenac, indomethacin, meloxicam, and others.
This list is not complete.
Other drugs may interact with furosemide.
These include prescription and over-the-counter medicines.
These also include vitamins and herbal products.

The relation 'contraindicated with' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug should not be used in combination with the substance or drug specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

B. 'should be avoided with': Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.
C. 'should not be used in place of': The subject entity should not be substituted for the object entity in treatment.
D. 'is not considered addictive': The subject drug is not considered addictive in the manner or context specified by the object entity.
